sentences.en: The structure of the house turned out to be faulty.
sentences.zh: 房子的结构被证明是有问题的。

sentences.en: The car was recalled because of a faulty air bag.
sentences.zh: 由于安全气囊有故障，这辆车被召回了。

sentences.en: The fluorescent light was faulty and flickered on and off intermittently.

senses.zh: 有缺陷的，有错误的；不正确的，有误的；有问题的，不完善的
